text:
[RDSC.7.5] `StreamHeader` is an event-trace framing atom and must not appear
in a DSC: it has no row in the [RDSC.7.1] registry. This keeps
a concatenated self-contained stream `[DSC][StreamHeader]` ([RFCS.13])
unambiguous: a reader walking the DSC atoms recognises the `StreamHeader` atom
as "DSC done, event trace begins" and never mistakes a DSC atom for it.

**The format makes a collision unrepresentable rather than merely
prohibited.** An atom's identity is its `oneof` field number
([RFCS.16.1]), and two members of one `oneof` cannot share a number.
What the rule protects, the [RFCS.13] boundary walk, holds
([RFCS.19.4]).

---
